name: Infant Death
overview: Scripture reveals that God intimately knows and values every life before birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5 where God sanctifies and ordains the unborn. Jesus demonstrates a special care for infants and children, welcoming them into His kingdom and rebuking those who would hinder their coming (Matthew 19:14; Luke 18:15-16). While Isaiah 65:20 foretells a future where infant death ceases, Psalms 34:18 assures that the Lord is close to the brokenhearted, offering comfort to those who grieve such loss.
